classifications.rationale: The President presently revokes an earlier proclamation and prohibits Libyan crude-oil imports, while also directing executive monitoring, reporting, discretionary regulations, and refund administration. These materially different self-executing and internal-management postures are inseparably combined in one supplied segment; the import prohibition and revocation take effect immediately, while agency actions occur later.
classifications.evidence: No crude oil produced in Libya may be imported into the United States, its territories or possessions.
